at-0003.content: Signal domain failures by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with the established codes: `invalid_state` for wrong invoice status, `invalid_quantity` for bad quantities, `negative_amount` for negative money. at-0007.title: Money operations take idempotency_key, checked first
at-0007.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment/credit/invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it before any state validation: scan `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an entry with the same key and return the original result without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` call.
